question: In how many years was the request for advice and help from the United Nations in the socio-economic development of this country?
explanation: In 1951, the then government of Pakistan appealed to the United Nations for advice and assistance on social welfare.

question: In which year a training course on professional social work was first introduced in the then Pakistan with the recommendation and assistance of the United Nations expert team?
explanation: In 1953, the first training course was started in Dhaka on the recommendation of the United Nations expert team.

question: What is social work as a profession?
explanation: Social work as a profession is navin (new). It gained recognition as a profession in the 20th century.

question: How many members were there in the United Nations Mission in Bangladesh in 1952?
explanation: The United Nations launched an effective aid program in 1952 with 6 members.

question: How does social work education develop in Bangladesh?

options.A: By application to United Nations in 1951 by Government of Pakistan
options.B: Through the aid program sent by the United Nations in 1952
options.C: Through training course in Dhaka in 1953
options.D: Through training course in 1955 at Burdwan House

explanation: In 1951, social work education was started in Bangladesh through the application of the Pakistan government to the United Nations.

question: Who has the important responsibility of introducing institutional education in social work?
explanation: Mr. Shawty was entrusted with the important responsibility of introducing institutional education in social work.

question: From which academic year was social work college established in Rajshahi University?
explanation: College of Social Work was established in Rajshahi University from the academic year 1961-1962.

question: When was the first social work knowledge development stage/training/professional social work foundation laid in Bangladesh?
explanation: In 1953, the foundation of professional social work was laid in Bangladesh through training courses.

question: Where is the social work training course organized by Mr. Shouty and Ms. Anama?
explanation: Mr. Shawty and Miss. Anama organized social work training course at Burdwan House.

question: In which year was the first international conference on social work?
explanation: First International Conference on Social Work was held in 1928.

question: What is the current name of Burdwan House?

options.D: College of Social Welfare and Research Centre

explanation: Present name of Burdwan House is Bangla Academy.

question: In which session did 'Social Work Education' under Dhaka University begin?
explanation: Social work education started in Dhaka University in 1964-65 session.

question: Where was social work course started in Dhaka in 1955?
explanation: In 1955 Social Work Course was started at Burdwan House.

question: What was the name of 'Social Welfare College and Research Center' changed under Dhaka University in 1973?

options.A: Institute of Social Welfare and Research
options.B: Institute of Social Work and Research
options.C: Center for Social Welfare and Research
options.D: Center for social work and research

explanation: In 1973 the name was changed to 'Institute of Social Welfare and Research'.

question: Which of the following is considered as one of the courses in social work?
explanation: Field Work Practicum is one of the most important courses in social work.

question: What is the rationale behind compulsory practical training for next 2 months after completion of Honors course (in social work)?

options.A: Acquiring the ability to apply the acquired knowledge in practice

explanation: This practical training is mandatory to acquire the ability to apply the acquired knowledge in practice.

question: When was the three-month training course launched in this country to prepare professional social workers?
explanation: In 1953 three months social work training course was started.

question: Why was National Social Service Academy established?

options.A: To arrange training for the officers and employees of the Department of Social Services
options.D: To modernize the social work profession

explanation: National Social Service Academy was established to train the officers and employees of Social Service Department.

question: Raina has acquired social work education from Dhaka University and is applying social work knowledge in Bardem, Dhaka Medical Hospital etc. What is the second phase of Raina's work called?
explanation: Application of social work knowledge in hospital is called medical social work.

question: Reasons for utilizing the knowledge and experience of social work in Bangladesh since the fifties- i. Bringing about planned social change ii. Solving social problems iii. To become a developed country
explanation: Social work knowledge is applied to planned social change and solving social problems.

question: Before the partition of the country most of the people of this country were far away- i. From touch of art ii. From the touch of digital iii. From the touch of modernity
explanation: Before partition people were away from the touch of industry and modernity. There was no digital technology then.

question: After the establishment of 'College of Social Work' in Rajshahi University, social work was introduced here- i. Masters Course ii. Graduate Course iii. degree course
explanation: Undergraduate and Masters courses were introduced in Rajshahi University.

question: Organizations in which internship opportunities are created for students to acquire social work field education in Bangladesh- i. Government agencies ii. Non-governmental organizations iii. international organization
explanation: Opportunities for fieldwork practice are created in all three types of organizations—public, private and international.

question: [Motivation] Complex problems and adverse situations of society → adopting multi-pronged agendas and methods to deal with problems and adverse situations → solving problems and achieving goals. Incentives can be a tool to achieve goals i. Social Security Agenda ii. Social Law iii. Social work method
explanation: All three tools can be used to achieve the goal.

question: Uddip is characterized by the branch of social science which has emerged as-
explanation: Uddeep is characterized by social work. The use of multifaceted agendas and methods is the nature of social work.

question: Which of the following was established by the then government of Pakistan to implement social welfare programs in Bangladesh?
explanation: The then Government of Pakistan established the National Social Welfare Council.

question: Which organization provides assistance in receiving hospital social services in Bangladesh?
explanation: The United Nations (UN) provides assistance to hospital social service activities in Bangladesh.

question: Who is the founder of BARD?
explanation: Dr. Akhtar Hamid Khan is the founder of BARD (Bangladesh Academy for Rural Development).

question: Application of professional social work in Bangladesh started through which program?
explanation: The application of professional social work in Bangladesh was initiated through the Social Work Training Scheme.

question: Social Welfare Department was renamed to what in 1984 on the recommendation of Administrative Reorganization Committee?
explanation: In 1984 the name of Department of Social Welfare was changed to Directorate of Social Services.

question: What is the name of the semi-annual magazine published regularly by Bangladesh Institute of Social Welfare and Research?
explanation: Journal of Social Development (Journal of Social Development) is a semi-annual magazine of the institute.

question: Which scriptural knowledge can be applied to the benefits of family planning and population control?
explanation: Knowledge of social work can be applied in family planning and population control.

question: Experimental urban social development program called 'Dhaka Project' was taken up in which year?
explanation: In 1954 experimental urban social development program called 'Dhaka Project' was started.

question: Activities undertaken based on the success of the city development program called 'Dhaka Project' in the financial year 1955-56- i. Undertaking Urban Social Development Project in Kayetuli ii. Medical social work started in Dhaka Medical College iii. Establishment of 'Social Welfare College and Research Center' under Dhaka University
explanation: Based on the success of the Dhaka project, all three activities were undertaken.

question: [stimulative] Mr. Moin is the entrepreneur of a voluntary organization. He formed 'Samajkarma Parishad' by combining some like-minded organizations. What is needed to protect the interests of social workers?

options.C: Raising the standards of the social work profession
options.D: Increasing the quality of social work education

explanation: Professional Social Work Organization is needed to protect the interests of social workers.

question: Through Moin Saheb's organization- i. Professional standards of social workers will increase ii. The interests of the employees will be protected iii. Employees will get status as profession
explanation: All three benefits can be obtained through professional organization.

question: What type of economy depends on administrative complexity in Bangladesh?
explanation: Administrative complications arise due to Bangladesh's mixed economy.

question: Which topic is specifically related to social work education in Bangladesh?
explanation: Undervaluation of the social work profession is a major problem associated with social work education in Bangladesh.

question: What is the cause of delay in implementation of social welfare programs in Bangladesh?

options.B: Not having a balanced flow of money

explanation: Bureaucratic Complexity creates delays in implementing social welfare programs.

question: Why is the development of the social work profession in Bangladesh disrupted?

options.A: Due to lack of professional organization
options.D: In the absence of government grants

explanation: Development of social work profession in Bangladesh is hampered due to lack of professional organization.

question: Why is it not possible to present the work of professional social workers in front of the people of the society?
explanation: Due to professional values ​​such as confidentiality, it is not possible to publicize the work of social workers.

question: How are private social welfare organizations hindering the development of the social work profession?
explanation: The development of the social work profession is hindered by the fact that many non-governmental organizations operate with a business mentality.

question: What is the means of making social work a popular profession?

options.B: Highlight the practical utility of social work

explanation: Bringing the practical utility of social work to the people is the means of popularizing it.

question: From how many years are social work subjects allowed at higher secondary level?
explanation: Since 1963, social work subjects have been allowed at higher secondary level.

question: Which characteristic is lacking to get status as a social work profession in Bangladesh?

options.A: Lack of dissemination of social work education
options.B: Lack of skills and qualifications of social workers
options.C: Lack of public welfare orientation of social work
options.D: There is no social and state recognition of profession in social work

explanation: There is a lack of social and state recognition of social work in Bangladesh.

question: What is the reason for people's negative attitude towards social work education?

options.A: Lack of opportunity to apply acquired knowledge
options.B: Lack of access to social respect

explanation: People have a negative attitude towards this profession as there are limited opportunities to earn money in social work.

question: Social workers in social work profession are not getting opportunity to evaluate- i. Lack of professional competence ii. Lack of professional organization iii. Lack of socio-economic environment
explanation: Social workers are not valued due to professional inadequacy and unfavorable socio-economic environment.

question: Reasons why society people do not value social workers- i. Lack of professional organization ii. Lack of political stability iii. Lack of professional inadequacy
explanation: Social workers are not valued due to lack of professional organization and political instability.

question: Requirements of professional organization are- i. For upgradation of profession ii. To protect the interests of the workers iii. To determine the ethical standards of the profession
explanation: Professional organization is necessary for three reasons. Quality improvement, protection of interests and determination of ethical standards.

question: Helping profession refers to- i. Invent ways to solve problems ii. Empowering the client to solve problems iii. Providing strategic assistance to the client in problem analysis
explanation: Social work as a helping profession does all three things. Innovation, capacity building and strategic support.
